text.en:
A new section to be known as Section 3-A is hereby included in republic act No. 1407 as
amended, which shall read as follows:
"Sec. 3-A. The funds provided in Sections 3 and 6 of this Act shall be available in the form of loans to citizens
of the Philippines or to associations or corporations organized under the laws of the Philippines, at least sixty
per cent of the capital of which is owned by citizens of the Philippines, engaged in shipbuilding and ship
repair and registered with the Board of Investments, for the purpose of financing and construction of
shipbuilding structures and facilities and for the purchase or acquisition of necessary equipments needed for
shipbuilding purposes.

Any provision of law, decree, executive order or rules and regulations inconsistent with this
Decree is hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 15th day of July, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
